evals.prompt: I just installed Ubuntu 24.04 on an x86_64 machine. I have Xcode_26.6_Universal.xip in ~/Downloads and I need to build a SwiftUI iPhone app here without a Mac. Set up the ubuntu-ios toolchain and prove it works.
evals.expected_output: Installs dependencies, Swift, xtool, rcodesign, pymobiledevice3, and the Darwin SDK from the supplied .xip; creates the launcher; runs doctor; performs an end-to-end SwiftUI build.
expectations: Installs liblzma-dev (or otherwise resolves the unxip lzma.h failure)
Uses the user's Xcode .xip and registers darwin in swift sdk list
Creates or uses ~/.local/bin/ubuntu-ios with the private library paths
Runs ubuntu-ios doctor and reports the expected no-device state
Builds a new SwiftUI project and confirms an arm64 Mach-O .app

evals.prompt: My Ubuntu box must use the corporate proxy http://127.0.0.1:7897. The ubuntu-ios installer fails during apt with 'Unable to connect to archive.ubuntu.com', and xtool sdk build later fails with HTTPClientError.connectTimeout. Walk me through fixing both and continue the install.
evals.expected_output: Explains that sudo strips proxy variables and configures apt explicitly; sets XTL_HTTP_PROXY in host:port form for xtool; re-runs the installer and verifies the SDK.
expectations: Configures apt to use the proxy (config file or explicit sudo env assignments)
Does not recommend a system-wide library replacement
Continues to a successful SDK registration and doctor run

evals.prompt: The ubuntu-ios installer is stuck cloning swift-syntax. The log shows: git clone ... --mirror https://github.com/swiftlang/swift-syntax.git /home/me/.cache/org.swift.swiftpm/repositories/swift-syntax-e1f983d3. Give me the exact manual command to prefetch it and then continue the installation without losing progress.
evals.expected_output: Stops the running clone/installer, removes the partial directory, mirror-clones into the exact -e1f983d3 path, verifies it is bare, and restarts the installer.
expectations: Uses the exact cache path with the -e1f983d3 suffix
Uses a --mirror bare clone, not a normal working-tree clone
Tells the user to stop the running installer/SwiftPM first
Restarts the installer and keeps the already-built SDK/OAM work

evals.prompt: ubuntu-ios is already working on my machine. I need to convert MyApp.xcodeproj, build it, and upload the build to TestFlight. I have an App Store Connect API key. What exactly do I run, and what must I keep out of git?
evals.expected_output: Runs ubuntu-ios convert with target/out/bundle-id, builds from the adapter directory, exports ASC_KEY_PATH/ASC_ISSUER_ID/ASC_KEY_ID, runs ubuntu-ios ship --upload, and calls out secrets and Apple SDK redistribution rules.
expectations: Builds from the generated adapter directory
Exports ASC_KEY_PATH, ASC_ISSUER_ID, and ASC_KEY_ID before ship --upload
Keeps the .p8 key outside the repository
Mentions that upload does not submit the app for review
